title: The spokesperson's burger
situation: During the 20 July clashes, the movement's spokesperson is filmed eating a burger away from the march. His defence video ("I'm not accountable") makes it worse; the party removes him the next day.
where: Near the march route, New Delhi

lines.text: Why did I eat a burger? This is a big issue today.
lines.speaker: Vijeta Dahiya

lines.text: We strongly condemn the deeply insensitive actions of our spokesperson Vijeta Dahiya
lines.speaker: CJP statement on X

paraphrased: Users asked why he was absent while supporters faced police.

buildThis.situation: Dev disappears for "five minutes" at 16:00; if the player films him at the CP burger counter during the charge, the clip ends his negotiating role.
